greet: Evening, {name}. Sit if you like, the bench is sound enough.
Well now, {name}. You've got a face that wants feeding.
Hm. {name}, is it? Pull up, then, but mind your elbows.
Good evening, {name}. Don't get in the way of the hearth.
Ah, {name}. Thought you'd be off somewhere with a bone to chew.
{name}, is it. Right. Nice to see a face that isn't scowling.
Evening to you, {name}. Shove over, that's my corner.
{name}. Aye, you'll do. Pass the salt, would you?
accept: Aye, I'll have that. Don't make a fuss about it.
Go on then, I've a bit of time yet. Thank you kindly.
Well, I'm not one to say no to a kind offer, am I?
Right you are. I'll take it, and I'll not owe you a thing back.
Oh, go on, why not. It's my one night off, after all.
Yes, all right. Just don't expect me to be chatty.
Right, I'm your woman. Let's see what you've got.
I suppose I can. Tell the lad to bring two, not one.
decline: No, thanks, {name}. Some of us have an early start.
Not tonight, {name}. My feet are done for.
Ah, bless you, but I'll pass. I'm content where I am.
Not for me, {name}. I've had my fill of such things for one day.
Thanks, but no. I've seen what your sort of fun does to a body.
No, {name}. I came for a bite, not a bother.
Kind of you to ask, but no. I'm keeping my own counsel.
No. Ask someone with more patience than I've got, {name}.
Not tonight, {name}. Maybe another week when I've not been on my feet since dawn.
pressed: Hold that thought, I've got to step out for a moment.
Pardon me, I'll be back directly. Don't go eating my supper.
Excuse me, I need to see to something. Won't be long.
I'll have to go a minute, mind my things while I'm gone.
Give me a moment, my dear, there's a call I can't ignore.
Right, I'm off for a bit. Keep the fire going, would you?
Sorry, I've got to go. Back before you've missed me.
Shan't be long. Don't let anyone take my place by the hearth.
Hang on, I must be off for a minute. Watch the bench for me.
I'll be a minute, love. Don't you dare start without me.
content: Well, that's my say said. Good company, but I'm away now.
Right, I've had my fill of talk for the night. Take care.
That's plenty for me, thanks all. I'll be getting along.
I'm done for now. You've been decent company, that's all I'll say.
Enough chatter for one night. Good luck to the lot of you.
I've said what I came to say, and I'm off to my bed.
That'll do. I'm heading home before the road gets dark.
Right, I'm content with that. Ta for the company, all of you.
Enough's enough. I'll leave you to your dice and your ale.
I've had my fill and I'm going. Mind yourselves.
closing: Last call's gone, so I'm off. Good night to you all.
Bell's rung, I'm away. Night, all, and mind the stairs.
That's closing time, is it? Right, I'm going. Goodnight.
Well, the barkeep's done, so so am I. Good night to the lot of you.
Time's up, so I'll be off. Sleep well, all of you.
Night, all. The bell's gone and so am I.
Closing, is it? Fair enough. Good night, then.
That's the bell. I'm off, and I'll see you next week, maybe.
Right, last one's gone. Good night and be careful on the road.
Off I go, then, since they're putting out the lamps. Goodnight.
